title: The Claude mobile app

body.text: Anthropic has a Claude app for
that gives a full experience on mobile. You can start new conversations, access Projects you created on desktop, and upload images straight from your camera or gallery. The

example: "[Take a photo of a Japanese food menu] Translate this menu to Thai and suggest dishes a beginner should try."

title: Making the most of Claude mobile

body.text: Claude mobile is great for use cases that need
convenience and speed throughout the day
— photograph a document and have Claude summarize it, ask questions by voice while driving, or copy-paste text from another app for Claude to revise. Everything
between mobile and desktop, so you can keep working seamlessly.

example: "[Take a photo of an English contract] Explain the main terms of this contract in simple Thai."
